# Prof. Dr.-Ing. Jan-Niklas Voigt-Antons — voigt-antons.de

## About

Prof. Dr.-Ing. Jan-Niklas Voigt-Antons is a Professor of Computer Science (Immersive Media) at Hamm-Lippstadt University of Applied Sciences (HSHL) in Germany, and Director of the Immersive Reality Lab. He holds a Dr.-Ing. (engineering doctorate) and was previously at TU Berlin.

His research focuses on:
- Extended Reality (XR) — including virtual, augmented, and mixed reality
- Quality of Experience (QoE) — linking technical system behavior to perceived quality
- Psychophysiology & Behavioral Measurement — EEG, eye tracking, physiological sensing
- Digital Health & Learning — XR for healthcare, education, and rehabilitation

He has 210+ publications and 2,700+ citations. He reviews for ACM CHI, IEEE ISMAR, ACM VRST, and QoMEX.

## Research lines

- XR & Spatial Interaction: embodied interaction, social acceptability, public-space MR
- Quality of Experience (QoE): VR cloud gaming, digital twins, trust and adoption
- Psychophysiology & Behavioral Measurement: EEG, eye tracking, multimodal fusion
- Digital Health & Learning: XR for rehabilitation, dementia care, health communication

## Active research projects

- DIDYMOS-XR (Horizon Europe Action Grant) — 13 partners, digital twin approaches for XR
- Digitalise SÜDWESTFALEN — regional digital transformation
- MIA-PROM — multimodal patient-reported outcomes
- ARiadne — AR-based health communication
- Virtuelles Institut AR/VR — NRW AR/VR competence cluster
